cases.name: no-clock
cases.why: no instant satisfies the witness policy, so expiry is not judged at all

cases.name: at-the-deadline
cases.why: expires == T has passed: the boundary two implementations disagree about

comment: the devices a node admits at evaluation time `t` (SPEC §5.3). `t` is the checkpoint's quorum time, never a wall clock, and t = 0 means there is no clock at all. A device is expired exactly when expires != 0 and expires <= t
